description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Puppeteer Clique trigger, putting a creature from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
